title: EMR -- cluster setup, node types, cost management
exp: EMR is AWS's managed Spark service. It costs money every second it runs. The most important command is terminate-cluster.
pts: Master node: YARN ResourceManager + Spark driver coordinator.
Core nodes: HDFS storage + compute. Use On-Demand -- losing one risks data loss.
Task nodes: compute only, no HDFS. Safe for Spot Instances.
KeepJobFlowAliveWhenNoSteps: False -- AUTO-TERMINATE when steps complete.
--deploy-mode cluster: driver runs on the cluster, not your laptop.
EMR Serverless: no cluster to manage; pay per job-second.
code:
import boto3
emr = boto3.client('emr', region_name='us-east-1')

response = emr.run_job_flow(
    Name='OrdersPipeline-2024', ReleaseLabel='emr-7.0.0',
    Applications=[{'Name':'Spark'}],
    Instances={
        'InstanceGroups':[
            {'Name':'Master','Market':'ON_DEMAND','InstanceRole':'MASTER',
             'InstanceType':'m5.xlarge','InstanceCount':1},
            {'Name':'Core','Market':'ON_DEMAND','InstanceRole':'CORE',
             'InstanceType':'m5.xlarge','InstanceCount':2},
            {'Name':'Task','Market':'SPOT','InstanceRole':'TASK',
             'InstanceType':'m5.xlarge','InstanceCount':4},
        ],
        'KeepJobFlowAliveWhenNoSteps': False,  # AUTO-TERMINATE!
    },
    Steps=[{'Name':'ProcessOrders','ActionOnFailure':'CONTINUE',
            'HadoopJarStep':{'Jar':'command-runner.jar',
                'Args':['spark-submit','--deploy-mode','cluster',
                        's3://bucket/scripts/pipeline.py']}}],
    JobFlowRole='EMR_EC2_DefaultRole', ServiceRole='EMR_DefaultRole',
    LogUri='s3://bucket/emr-logs/')

cluster_id = response['JobFlowId']
emr.terminate_job_flows(JobFlowIds=[cluster_id])  # emergency terminate

viz.note: EMR cluster: Master (On-Demand) + Core (On-Demand, HDFS) + Task (Spot, compute only). Auto-terminates when steps complete.

qa.q: What is KeepJobFlowAliveWhenNoSteps and why is it critical?
qa.a:
**Elevator Pitch:** When False: the cluster auto-terminates when all Steps finish. When True: the cluster stays running indefinitely -- a major cost leak. An EMR cluster left running overnight with 6 instances costs ~$50. Always set False for production jobs and add a CloudWatch alarm as a safety net.

**Under the Hood & Mechanics:** Cloud control plane APIs orchestrate virtualized hardware, networking (VPC/VNets), IAM policies, and auto-scaling groups.

**Production Failure Mode & Gotcha:** Overly permissive IAM roles (wildcard actions) or unmonitored resource limits lead to security breaches and unexpected cloud cost spikes.

**Senior Trade-Off Signal:** Serverless/managed services eliminate infrastructure maintenance but introduce cold starts and vendor lock-in.

qa.q: What is the difference between Core and Task nodes?
qa.a:
**Elevator Pitch:** Core nodes run HDFS storage AND compute -- losing one risks data loss. Task nodes run only compute, no HDFS -- safe for Spot Instances since if reclaimed, Spark reschedules the failed tasks with no data loss. Never put core or master on Spot in production.

**Under the Hood & Mechanics:** Cloud control plane APIs orchestrate virtualized hardware, networking (VPC/VNets), IAM policies, and auto-scaling groups.

**Production Failure Mode & Gotcha:** Overly permissive IAM roles (wildcard actions) or unmonitored resource limits lead to security breaches and unexpected cloud cost spikes.

**Senior Trade-Off Signal:** Serverless/managed services eliminate infrastructure maintenance but introduce cold starts and vendor lock-in.
